table.name: TLGNC_FIREQ_MATERIAL_MIXDESIGN
table.description: Mix design itself is created/maintained in FireQ (master of this data) and is like a bill of material - some sort of recipe which components the material is composed of. Since LOGON is not the master of this data it should be handled as reference data in some aspects but not technically! At the moment there is no direct FireQ interface in LOGON. All Mix Design updates/inserts are triggered by the LDS at start/end load and when completed orders are created.

column.name: MIX_DESIGN_ID
column.description: PK. Technical key, given by LOGON.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. The SAP Material to withc the Mix Design belongs.

column.name: PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. Production Plant which produced this mix of materials (aggregate).

column.name: MIX_DESIGN_CD
column.description: Combined Aggregate ID or RMX Mixdesign, unique.
